nodes.label: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / ANON_KEY Env Vars
nodes.rationale: Never expose Supabase service role/secret key in browser-exposed variables.

frontmatter.name: feature-commit
frontmatter.description: Review, commit and push work one feature at a time. Use automatically as soon as a feature (one coherent, working change) is finished, without waiting to be asked; also when the user says /feature-commit, 'commit this', or 'push'. Splits the working tree into one commit per feature, runs type-check, lint, tests and a code review on each, then pushes the current feature branch.

nodes.label: Post-commit auto-rebuild hook
nodes.rationale: Triggers once per commit with no background process; only code files are re-extracted via AST, docs need manual --update.

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion
nodes.rationale: The query matcher is case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming or synonyms, so questions must be expanded against the graph's own vocabulary without inventing tokens.

nodes.label: build_merge replace-on-re-extract
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly to preserve edge direction (#801); changed files are replaced rather than pruned so re-extracted content is not deleted (#1344).

nodes.label: Fast path: query existing graph
nodes.rationale: If graph.json exists and the request is a question, skip rebuild steps and query directly.

nodes.label: Honesty rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent edges; use AMBIGUOUS when unsure; always show token cost and raw cohesion scores.

nodes.label: Manifest and semantic stamping
nodes.rationale: Only semantic files that actually produced output are stamped so failed chunks are re-queued on the next --update (#2015).

nodes.label: Parallel semantic extraction subagents (Part B)
nodes.rationale: Only content files go to semantic extraction; code is covered by AST to avoid re-reading every source file (#1392).

nodes.label: Shrink guard (#479)
nodes.rationale: to_json refuses to write a graph smaller than the existing graph.json so an empty or failed extraction never clobbers a good graph.

nodes.label: graphify Knowledge Graph Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Use graphify query/path/explain for scoped subgraphs instead of raw grep or full report; run `graphify update .` after code changes to keep graph current.

nodes.label: Next.js Breaking Changes Notice
nodes.rationale: Installed Next.js version differs from training data; read node_modules/next/dist/docs before writing code. Block is auto-regenerated by next dev.

nodes.label: UI Self-check Before Finishing
nodes.rationale: After any UI/frontend change, verify in a real browser (dev server, Playwright MCP screenshot, console errors, click-through) before declaring done.

nodes.label: Apple Touch Icon (two overlapping circles)
